deploy-bot: [STAGING] Deploy started by @carol. Environment=staging. Commit=833a2d7 (tag: `v2026-03-18`). Change window=2026-03-18 22:00-23:00 UTC. Rollout plan=progressive streaming (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Health checks=runtime-smoke, reranker-smoke, kvcache-check. Runbook=/runbooks/staging-deploy-2026-03-18. Canary policy=stable-after-5min.

carol: Kicking this off. I'll watch the dashboards and smoke logs. Ping me for any aborts. :rocket:

david: first canary (5%) smoke passed locally. p50/p95 look fine, p95 ~220ms which is within SLO. quick log note: `hydra-orch: canary-01 OK`.

erin: seeing DB connection pool tick up on one replica, will patch pool size if it stays. tagging @maria in case reranker pins needed.

maria: requesting we pin reranker to `reranker:v2.3.1` on staging only — saw a minor QA regression last night. Prefer pin for this wave.

carol: ok, pin approved for staging. Applying now.

carol: ```
redwoodctl pin model reranker:v2.3.1 --env=staging --reason="regression-qa-pin"
```

deploy-bot: Canary moved 5% -> 25%. Health checks=green. Telemetry: token throughput +8%, latency stable.

david: small error bump on one canary pod (0.02% -> 0.15%) with an NPE in transformer client stack. Collecting traces.

erin: root cause looks like a sidecar config mismatch after the pin. I can patch and restart the affected pod.

deploy-bot: Canary paused by safety-latch due to error spike at 25%. Rollout on hold. Reason=error-rate-threshold-exceeded.

carol: decision time — rollback the pin or patch?

maria: patch is low-risk and quick. prefer patch + resume; rollback would reintroduce QA regression.

erin: applied config fix and restarted pod. Re-running smoke.

david: smoke rerun shows error rate back to baseline, traces look clean. p95 stable.

deploy-bot: Safety-latch cleared. Resuming rollout to 100% streaming.

carol: monitoring during ramp to 100%. nothing alarming so far. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deployment complete — ENV=staging, commit=833a2d7, tag=`v2026-03-18`. Duration=~14m. Canary progression: 5% -> 25% (hold) -> resumed -> 100%. Notes=pin applied for reranker:v2.3.1 (staging-only), quick sidecar config patch during hold. Release notes draft=/docs/release-notes/2026-03-18-staging.md. 

maria: ack. I'll follow up with a short post-deploy QA run and add a note to the runbook about the sidecar mismatch. ✅

carol: thanks all — closing the loop. :thumbsup:
